It blocks prostaglandin biosynthesis. Chemically, it is 1-(4-chlorobenzoyl)-5-methoxy-2-methyl-1H-indole-3-acetic acid.C19H16ClNO4) prepared synthetically and used for the treatment of pain and arthritis.
